name: KNJIGE / ANTIKVARIAT
description:
Iskanje po knjigah pri nas. Iskalnik vpraša Mladinsko knjigo (emka) in po želji Bolho.

Slovenski antikvariati zavrnejo vsak program, tudi svoj robots.txt, zato jih ne moremo iskati sami — odpremo jih, naslov pa poiščete pri njih.
descriptionEn:
A book lookup in Slovene shops. It asks Mladinska knjiga (emka) and, if you tick the box, Bolha classifieds.

The Slovene antiquariats refuse every program, robots.txt included, so the cell cannot search them — it opens them instead and you search there.
